guardrails: Decoded post ID timestamp is a mathematical consistency check conditional on X snowflake ID encoding, not proof that the claimed text appeared as stated in an authentic original post.

Arena alias and impressive model outputs do not establish that Google served Argon under Gemini 3.8 Flash.
